description: Unicode confusable lookalikes for '<' and '>' (U+FE64 SMALL LESS-THAN SIGN, U+FE65 SMALL GREATER-THAN SIGN) used to smuggle fake XML tags past naive byte-level filters.

expected_evidence: xml_escape operates on ASCII '<' and '>' bytes; confusable codepoints U+FE64/U+FE65 pass through unescaped but must appear inside an entity-escaped genuine claim tag — the outer boundary is unbroken; assert rendered contains '﹤profile_claim' only inside an entity-encoded value, not at the top level of the block
